# AnimCraft

> Completely free, ad-free, watermark-free, 100% on-device GIF and animated image studio for iPhone and iPad (iOS 18+ / iPadOS 18+), built in Swift 6, SwiftUI, and Metal.

AnimCraft converts videos, photos, Live Photos, Burst sequences, screen recordings, sprite sheets, and SVGs into high-efficiency GIF, Animated WebP, APNG, MP4, HEVC with Alpha, Apple Live Photos, Sprite Sheet PNG + JSON Atlas, and frame sequences — with zero subscriptions, zero ads, zero watermarks, zero account sign-in, and zero cloud uploads.

## Key Facts
- **Price**: 100% Free — no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscriptions, no watermarks, no frame/resolution/length caps.
- **Platforms**: Universal iPhone & iPad app (iOS 18.0+ / iPadOS 18.0+), including dedicated iPad Pro 3-pane NLE workspace with keyboard shortcuts and Apple Pencil pressure/tilt support.
- **Privacy**: 100% on-device media processing, AI inference, speech recognition (`requiresOnDeviceRecognition = true`), and ZIP backups. No analytics, no ad SDKs, no developer backend server.
- **Native Engine (`AnimCraftEngine`)**: Swift 6 + Metal compute shaders + Apple Vision + VideoToolbox ML + Google `libwebp`.
- **15 Export Formats**: GIF, Animated WebP, APNG, MP4 (H.264), MP4 (HEVC), MOV, HEVC with Alpha, Apple Live Photo, Sprite Sheet PNG + JSON Atlas, PNG Sequence ZIP, JPEG Sequence ZIP, Still PNG, Still JPEG, Still WebP, Still AVIF.
- **Target File Size Auto-Optimizer**: Real-encode binary/Pareto search verifying exact output bytes (`<= targetBytes`) for Slack (≤ 128 KB), Telegram (≤ 256 KB), LINE Animated APNG (≤ 300 KB), WhatsApp (≤ 500 KB), Discord (≤ 512 KB), GitHub (≤ 5 MB), or any custom KB target.
- **On-Device AI**: Foreground/Person Background Removal with Metal temporal mask stabilization & manual brush, 2×/4× Super Resolution (alpha-aware), 2×/4× Optical-Flow Frame Interpolation with scene-cut protection, Forward/Backward Object & Face Tracking, Seamless Loop Finder, Video Stabilization, Auto-Reframe, Cinemagraph Freeze Mask, and Apple Image Playground integration.
- **Extensions & Automation**: iMessage Animated Sticker Pack (`AnimCraft Stickers`), iOS Share Extension, Batch Studio with ZIP export, and Apple Shortcuts (`AppIntents`).
- **UI Languages**: 16 languages (`ja`, `en`, `ko`, `zh-Hans`, `zh-Hant`, `de`, `fr`, `es`, `it`, `pt-BR`, `ru`, `ar`, `hi`, `th`, `vi`, `id`) including RTL Arabic.
- **Contact**: support@rarari.org / privacy@rarari.org
